test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statements: **

I. All blankets are bedsheet.

II. No bedsheet is a curtain.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some bedsheet are blanket.

II. No curtain is a blanket.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

I. All blankets are bedsheet.

II. No bedsheet is a curtain.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0afecd92a17776a4acf572cc88afdb78f7654a2b69aed4091173eb96764fe28.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bedsheet are blanket - True (All blankets are bedsheet it means some blankets will be also bedsheet).

II. No curtain is a blanket - True (Because, All blankets are bedsheet and No bedsheet is a curtain, so all the Blankets are part of Bedsheet that is not Curtain, it also means No curtain is a blanket).

So, Both conclusion I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
